george-herbert-mead.oneLineEn: Built a theory of the social self via I/me distinction and role-taking.

george-santayana.oneLineEn: At the border of naturalism, skepticism, and aesthetics; Life of Reason and Realms of Being.

georges-bataille.oneLineEn: Explored the sacred and transgression through expenditure, excess, and general economy.

georges-sorel.oneLineEn: Reflections on Violence made social myth and revolutionary syndicalism a heterodox Marxist path.

gilbert-ryle.oneLineEn: The Concept of Mind's 'ghost in the machine' critique of dualism grounded ordinary-language philosophy.

gilbert-simondon.oneLineEn: Recast philosophy of technology through individuation and the mode of existence of technical objects.

giovanni-gentile.oneLineEn: Founder of actual idealism; pure act of thinking as sole reality, diverging from Croce.

hans-jonas.oneLineEn: The Imperative of Responsibility set ethical demands on technological civilization for future generations.

heinrich-rickert.oneLineEn: Refined cultural-science methodology via value-relation; direct background to Weber's method.

henry-sidgwick.oneLineEn: Systematizer of classical utilitarianism; Methods of Ethics set a technical frame after Mill.

jacques-maritain.oneLineEn: Neo-Thomist who supplied philosophical arguments for the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

jaimini.oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Mīmāṃsā Sūtra; early Mīmāṃsā ritual hermeneutics takes its stand here.

jan-patocka.oneLineEn: Czech phenomenologist and Charter 77 spokesman; care of the soul as historical existence.

jane-addams.oneLineEn: Hull House founder who carried pragmatism into social reform and the peace movement.

jankelevitch.oneLineEn: Wrote the fine grain of moral experience through the almost-nothing and the unforgivable.

jean-luc-nancy.oneLineEn: Inoperative community and being-with ontology in response to Heidegger and Bataille.

jjc-smart.oneLineEn: Mind-brain identity theory and consequentialism under a thoroughgoing scientific realism.

jl-austin.oneLineEn: Source of speech-act theory; How to Do Things with Words moved language from meaning to action.

john-mcdowell.oneLineEn: Mind and World holds experience already conceptual, reconnecting analysis with Hegel.

jose-ortega-y-gasset.oneLineEn: Advocate of ratiovitalism and perspectivism; The Revolt of the Masses critiques mass society.

josiah-royce.oneLineEn: American absolute idealist and philosopher of community, centering ethics on loyalty.

judith-jarvis-thomson.oneLineEn: Violinist argument and trolley problem reshaped applied ethics' case tradition.

judith-shklar.oneLineEn: Rebuilt liberalism around the liberalism of fear and a priority concern with cruelty.

kanada.oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Vaiśeṣika Sūtra; Vaiśeṣika atomism and categories take their stand here.

karl-lowith.oneLineEn: Argued that modern progress historiography is a secularized Christian eschatology.

koyre.oneLineEn: From the Closed World to the Infinite Universe rewrote Scientific Revolution history, shaping Kuhn.

lacan.oneLineEn: Reread Freud via the mirror stage and the claim that the unconscious is structured like a language.

leo-strauss.oneLineEn: Revived classical political philosophy and reread the ancients-moderns quarrel via esoteric writing.

leszek-kolakowski.oneLineEn: Author of Main Currents of Marxism; moved from revisionism to religious questioning of utopia.

levi-strauss.oneLineEn: Founded structural anthropology through kinship structures and myth analysis.
